pages.text: The Life Breeder attaches $(reset)traits$(reset) to an organ.$(br2)$(bold)Requirements:$(reset) the organ must be $(bold)non-native and set$(reset), with room left below the trait cap.$(br2)$(bold)Cost:$(reset) 1 same-source gene sequence, 2 Exhausted Crystals and 60,000 life energy, over 1,000 ticks (50 seconds).$(br2)$(bold)Success rate:$(reset) scales linearly with sequence purity — about 35% at purity 25, up to 70% at purity 100.$(br2)Success duplicates the organ and attaches 1 random trait; failure keeps the organ, but $(reset)materials are still consumed$(reset).

$(bold)Traits come in tiers 1-3$(reset); which tiers can roll is set by the breeding sequence's purity:$(li)purity <60: tier 1 only$(li)60-84: tiers 1-2$(li)≥85: every tier unlocked$(br2)Each roll is roughly $(reset)70% benign / 30% aberrant$(reset) — seven in ten are pure gains, three in ten come with a price tag (see "$(l:akaishi:trait_dual)Aberrant Traits$(/l)").$(br2)Higher-tier traits require a steady supply of high-purity sequences, which is what the Cultivator provides.

$(bold)【Tier 1 · Safe traits】$(reset)$(br2)$(li)Dense Tissue (dense_tissue): +1 armor$(li)Muscle Fiber (muscle_fiber): +1 attack damage$(li)Hyperactive Marrow (marrow_hyper): +3 max health$(li)Reflex Neurons (reflex_neuron): +0.4 attack speed$(li)Elastic Tendon (elastic_tendon): +1.5% move speed$(br2)All tier 1 traits are purely positive, stable and free of side effects, making them a good baseline.

$(bold)【Tier 2 · Safe traits】$(reset)$(br2)$(li)Night-Vision Retina (night_retina): permanent night vision$(li)Gill Slits (gill_slit): water breathing$(li)Bioluminescent Cells (glow_cells): self-glow$(li)Carapace Growth (carapace_growth): +2 armor, +0.2 knockback resistance$(li)Venom Gland (venom_gland): attacks inflict poison$(br2)Passive traits appear from tier 2 onward.

$(bold)【Tier 3 · Safe traits】$(reset)$(br2)$(li)Crystal Carapace (crystal_carapace): +1.5 armor, reflects melee damage$(li)Shadow Vein (shadow_vein): chance to blink-dodge when hit$(li)Stem Cell Regeneration (stem_regen): continuous regeneration$(li)Jump Tendons (jump_tendons): jump boost$(br2)Tier 3 is the ceiling for safe traits; stronger values usually require an "$(l:akaishi:trait_dual)aberration$(/l)" as the cost.
Suggested order: catalogs on this page and "Aberrant Traits"; trait replacement via "Trait Reforger"; traits attach to organs, whose source is covered in "Organ Construction".
